core_requests: Pivot tags: res.pivot(..., tags=['c2','hostile']) applied to the target node so the P376/GUARD-01 contact guard sees Triage config C2s, Triage dropper URLs and MalShare collection URLs as hostile (today: expand=False + 'hostile:' note + c2 tag on the hash finding).

Dataset manager keyed URL templates ({AUTH_KEY} substituted at download time, redacted) so the abuse.ch CSCB export (P351 FC3) and the MalwareBazaar full export (P351 FC5 '> 500 samples' counts) can be registered and refreshed by `v3lum data update`.

Provider extensions (v3lum.provider-ext/1) able to add keys, or one owner for the OPSWAT fragments: the keyed MetaDefender API needed its own fragment opswat_metadefender next to metadefender (p2-G14-3); likewise V3LUM_FILESCAN_KEY cannot be added to filescan.
abusech key env aliases V3LUM_ABUSECH_KEY and V3LUM_ABUSECH_AUTH_KEY in the core seed abusech.json (same request as p1-G07-1/p1-G07-2).

A wire-bytes (compressed-size) cap option in ctx.http, or an architect decision on P178 FC3: max_bytes counts decoded bytes, so popular hashes (EICAR: 3.5 MB decoded, 0.84 MB brotli) end ERROR 'response too large'.

A quota feedback hook so a module can report the provider's own remaining budget (MetaDefender X-RateLimit-*, MalShare getlimit) to the P334 quota book; and doctor/keys-wizard key tests (WP25) for MalShare getlimit and PolySwarm /v3/public/accounts.
notes: P177: one module per provider in the council's order (triage, metadefender, then malshare, polyswarm, virusshare) in one source-family file, each with its own key, provider/source, terms, quota and tests; all default_enabled False. FC2 allow-lists (check_request/guard) run before every request and are unit-tested against 38 forbidden download/submission/delete endpoints from the providers' docs; usable_key() ignores empty/placeholder keys (FC4). Terms: triage/metadefender 'noncommercial' (free plans), malshare/polyswarm/virusshare 'unknown'; tiers trusted (Recorded Future, OPSWAT, PolySwarm) and community (MalShare, VirusShare). One vote per adapter via distinct upstream families; MetaDefender and Filescan share 'opswat' (P171). Providers: created malshare.json, polyswarm.json and opswat_metadefender.json (api.metadefender.com was unowned; 'metadefender' belongs to p2-G14-3 and extensions cannot add keys); extended triage (source triage_overview), virusshare (HTTP 204 rate-limit marker) and filescan (source filescan_reputation; www.filescan.io was already owned, so the council's 'opswat_filescan' id could not be created - backlog). FC6: only VirusShare's success fixture is real; Triage's are documented examples; MetaDefender/MalShare/PolySwarm are synthetic until a key holder captures one (backlog gate). Triage C2 pivots are communicates_with with expand=False and a hostile note (pivots cannot carry tags yet - core request); credentials, ransom notes, keys and file names from Triage configs are dropped. P178: keyless reputation lookup only, max_bytes 2 MB, truncated -> ERROR never parsed, res.raw = {verdict, tags, report_ids}; live EICAR answer is 3.5 MB decoded so it ends ERROR (architect decision in backlog). P351: accepts the P333 structural types plus md5/sha1/sha256 (YARAify values) and code_signing_cert (CSCB: local copy, else the documented keyed get_cscb query, high malicious-signer finding); MalwareBazaar get_imphash/get_tlsh/get_telfhash/get_gimphash/get_dhash_icon (limit 50) and get_issuerinfo/get_subjectinfo; similar_to pivots 0.3-0.6, expand=False, findings <= low tagged hypothesis; stoplist + >10 signatures + installer-stub rules; grouped headlines with top 10; licence gate via ctx.allowed_sources (MalwareBazaar 'license' off under corporate, YARAify open). FC6 case-level ssdeep similarity is the correlation rule p3g072_case_fuzzy_similarity (identical digests always, scored with the optional ppdeep extra; TLSH distance not implemented). No LIGHT/ACTIVE variants were asked. Removed unused prep fixtures (MalShare getlimit, VirusShare quick/source, CSCB legacy 410); CSCB doc fixture company names replaced by example names. Gates: batch module tests, rule fixtures, registry contract for the 7 modules, P327 lint (0 issues), ruff clean.
